Before starting Tailmesh, stop any other VPN app currently running on this device.
Tailmesh is an independent Android client built on the open-source Tailscale client. It adds a multi-Tailnet proxy mode while retaining compatibility with Tailscale-style Tailnets.

When Tailmesh is used with Tailscale\'s hosted service, account and coordination data is handled under Tailscale\'s applicable policies. Tailmesh also stores app and profile state locally. Review the selected service\'s terms and privacy policy before signing in.

If this profile uses Tailscale\'s hosted service, account and tailnet deletion requests are handled by Tailscale Support. Use the Contact Tailscale Support button below for hosted-service account requests.
